content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to show the status of multiple blocks on a single screen? For example: "I1 ON, Q2 OFF, Latching Relay 1 ON, Block012 OFF," and so on. Also, can we customize the text shown for ON and OFF states? Thanks!
Have you tried using the message texts function block?
You can use the "Message text" block, which includes an "ON/OFF" function. Please check the attachment for details.
Thank you! I was using the message texts function block but didn't notice the ON/OFF button. Is there a "TRUE" block as well? Thanks.
Yes, the text can be changed—the default is ON and OFF.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on how to display multiple block states on a single interface, as well as customizing the text for ON/OFF states using message texts blocks. Users discover that these features exist, but some options may be overlooked due to unclear documentation or interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily display multiple block statuses together and personalize the text shown for ON/OFF states.
